sections.title: Identification and habit
sections.text: The catalogue entry Cytisus refers here to Cytisus scoparius, common broom, rather than the whole genus. This European shrub is usually 1–1.5 m tall. Its green branches are angular and bear small leaves, often trifoliate near the base.

sections.title: Flowers and toxicity
sections.text: The yellow pea-shaped flowers develop into pods. The plate matches the green branches, flowers and pods. The whole plant is toxic if eaten; its seeds and other parts are not food.
